rule_text: Defeating enemies in Weekly Challenge to earn Weekly Challenge Points. Earning points will grant rewards at certain thresholds. Point Rewards are refreshed each week.

Players can switch the difficulty level of the challenge at any time. The higher the difficulty, the higher the point bonus; points between levels of difficulty will not be accumulated; you will only be rewarded based on the highest number of points
You can borrow characters from fellow Organization members in Challenge, but this action will affect the points you can earn.
Weekly Challenge has a turn limit. On any difficulty, failing to defeat all enemies within 5 turns results in battle failure.
Base Points =500+ Total Damage *0.004+ Best Single Damage *0.005+ Total Attribute Restraint Damage *0.0065
Your points are reduced by 20% for each borrowed character.
· The rankings will be finalized weekly from 0:00 AM to 5:00 AM %utc% every Monday. The Challenge Points earned during the finalization period will not be included in the calculation.
Join an active organization on day 1. Only the top 8 organizations in that week's Weekly Challenge can enter guild war.

DMG Increase: When an enemy target uses a triggered Skill, grants self with an effect of a 20% increase in damage taken, stacking up to 5 times. Retaliation: When your turn starts, grant yourself a 15% increase in ATK-related stats,stacking up to 3 times, and deal [Blood Piercer] damage of 120% ATK to an random debuffed enemy || *Blood Piercer: When attacked, the target takes additional damage of 10% of Blood Piercer applier's ATK for 2 turns.

# Weekly Challenge (mode id boss-weekly) cite: mode:boss-weekly (the fight) or mode:boss-weekly#N (row N below) Tip: You get 5 turns, and only your best run counts. Tip: Use units that beat its attribute: that damage scores the most. Tip: Hit hard while it is above 50% HP, and use area attacks (+50%). Boss mechanics are the game's own text, written from the boss's side: his "allies"/"allied Character" are the boss's side (his parts and adds), "enemies" are your team. Boss mechanic — Weak: Changes your Weak cap to 6 as battle starts. Weak effect increases the skill level of all Skills of 1 random enemy instead of Stunning you.
The Organization Boss game is divided into two Phases: Knockback Phase and the Bonus Phase.
The Knockback Phase refreshes every Monday and Friday. You can only enter the Bonus Phase after defeating a Boss.

The Bonus Phase lasts from the moment the Boss is defeated until the next Knockback Phase refresh. The longer the Bonus Phase lasts, the greater the potential rewards, so work together with your team to defeat the Boss as quickly as possible!
In Knockback Phase, players need to defeat the Organization Boss as soon as possible to get Points. The fewer days it takes to complete Knockback, the higher the Point bonus.
Random Battle Buff drops when enemy HP drops to a specific phase.
Each member can only use one Buff at a time; members can also borrow from each other.
During the Bonus Phase, the progress of receiving rewards will increase over time. When the progress is complete, all members of the Organization can receive rewards.

·When the player's Chain Campaign Depth reaches Lv.15, the World Boss will be unlocked.
·Players have 3 chances to challenge the Boss every day, and no deduction of chances if they quit halfway.
·The Boss cannot be killed. After a certain period of time, the Boss will leave.
·Each time you challenge the Boss, you will get some reward.
·When the accumulative damage caused to the Boss reaches a certain level, you will receive corresponding rewards.
·After the boss leaves, the finalization begins. The top 100 players who have caused most accumulative damage to the Boss will receive rewards.

World Boss (Damage race): Attack daily: you get 3 attempts a day, and every challenge pays a reward. Aim for damage milestones; single-battle and accumulated damage both pay. Remember the boss can't be killed; it leaves after a while and the top 100 get ranking rewards. Tip: Quitting halfway doesn't use an attempt.

Restrict Underbelly: When receiving damage from restricting Attribute, you will be granted an effect of 15% reduction in DEF-related stats. Stacking up to 5 times.

Shield Retaliation: After the shield effect disappears or breaks, deal 260% of the enemy's ATK to the target with the highest ATK, applying [Lethal] for 1 turn. || *Lethal: Unable to trigger any healing effects. Restriction Boost: When receiving damage from restricted Attribute, you will be granted an effect of 5% increase in ATK-related stats. Stacking up to 5 times.

World Boss 3: Kureo Mado (SPD) (World Boss, untested plan): Attack Boost: When your turn starts, you will be granted an effect of increase in ATK-related stats by 10% and enemies will be granted an effect of reduction in DEF-related stats by 10%. Stacking up to 3 times. Debuff Retaliation: When taking active Skill damage, if the attacker has debuffs, Retaliate the target, causing [Underbelly] damage equal to 180% of your ATK. || *Underbelly: If the target is debuffed, this damage will be increased by 15% Disabling Boost: When any enemy target dies, deal damage of 160% ATK to the enemy target with the highest ATK, applying [Stun] for 1 turn. || *Stunned: Unable to take any actions.

·Stronghold Takeover will be opened along with Carnival
·After the event officially starts, you can start from the Base to occupy Strongholds. The Base cannot be attacked.

·After occupying a Stronghold, the Stronghold will start to increase its reward progress. When the designated reward progress is reached, rewards will be distributed to all members of the Organization occupying the Stronghold at that time.

·From time to time, Stronghold Points will be issued based on the number and level of Strongholdes currently occupied by the Organization. At the end of the Event, the occupied Strongholdes will also provide a portion of Stronghold Points
·Occupy a Stronghold of another Organization to compete for the Stronghold Points stored there.
·The battle for the Stronghold requires the use of Teams to fight. When a Team participates in the battle, the HP consumed in the battle will not be restored immediately
·Before the preparation phase starts, only the top 8 organizations in the Weekly Challenge rankings within the server are eligible to participate in the Stronghold Takeover.
·Before the official start of the Stronghold Takeover, a preparation phase will begin. During this phase, you can perform operations such as deploying formations and viewing map info.

The Stronghold Annihilation opens with the Carnival\n·Only Top 3 organizations from the weekly Stronghold Takeover can participate.\n·Before the event starts, there is a Preparation Phase where you can set lineups and view the map

·Once the event begins, you can send teams to attack different strongholds. Defeat defenders to earn Annihilation Points and rewards based on rankings
·Strongholds have multiple levels with different defender counts, CP, and rewards
·Each stronghold has a required CP. Teams below this cannot attack the stronghold
·When all defenders of a stronghold are defeated, the stronghold is settled. Organizations are ranked by total Annihilation Points from their members

The Stronghold Annihilation uses 1 team per battle. HP lost in battle is not restored immediately
·It takes time for characters who died in battle to recover. The consumed HP will slowly recover after some time outside the battle
Diamonds and Quick Recovery Potion can be used to revive team members. If the team is revived continuously, the consumed Diamonds will increase
Using Quick Recovery Potions or Diamonds for instant revival will grant Revival Points corresponding to the cost. Exchange Revival Points in the exclusive Revival Point Shop for items

Stronghold Annihilation (Organization war (top 3 only)): Set your lineups and study the map during the Preparation Phase. Send a team at a stronghold; each battle uses 1 team. Check each stronghold's required CP and attack the highest-level one your team qualifies for. Defeat defenders for Annihilation Points; rewards follow the rankings. Rotate teams: lost HP is not restored right away, and fallen units recover slowly (Diamonds or Quick Recovery Potions revive instantly). Tip: Only revive with Diamonds when your Organization calls a push.

· In Conquest Battle, you should formulate tactics according to the characteristics of the enemy
· During the battle, if you strike at the enemy's weak points, you can earn additional rewards when the battle is won
· Starting Conquest Battle costs stamina. Failing costs only 1 Stamina
· Conquest Coupons are restored over time. No attempt will be deducted unless you claim victory.
·After clearing [Yamori] Conquest - Abyss, you will unlock the challenge of difficulty Formidable. To unlock the subsequent Formidable BOSS, you need to clear the previous Formidable BOSS
·You can invite other players online to challenge Formidable BOSS together
·Challenges do not consume Stamina
When a certain number of teams successfully complete the Formidable Challenge in this server, players can receive rewards.

Conquest Battle (bosses) and Formidable (Boss dungeon (co-op)): Read the boss's characteristics, then set a team that answers them. Strike the boss's weak points during the fight for extra rewards. Invite other players to fight together if you can't solo it. Only spend attempts you can win: Conquest Coupons are deducted only on victory, and a failed start costs just 1 Stamina. For Formidable bosses (no Stamina cost), clear them in order; server-wide clear counts unlock bonus rewards. Tip: Farm the boss of the Modification path you chose for Nutcracker's cells (then Rize's).
Bring attributes that beat the boss: STR beats SKL, SKL beats SPD, SPD beats STR. Merge skill cards to Lv3 before you cast. Stun and full Weak stop counters; Disruption does not.

During the event, players can participate in the Global Stronghold War, competing with top organizations worldwide for strongholds and rankings. In addition to stronghold battles, the event will also feature Event Sign-in, Event Prediction, Commemorative Shop, and Event Pass. Players can earn exclusive event rewards by participating.
Each Stronghold Battle lasts 1 hour, and all battlefield groups worldwide will open simultaneously at the designated time.
To ensure fair play, different event phases may have different character bans.
Banned characters cannot be placed into stronghold battle teams. If a banned character is already in the player's current team, they must replace the character before participating in battle.
Character ban rules only take effect during the corresponding event phase and in designated regions, and do not affect the normal use of characters in other game modes.
The Global Stronghold War schedule consists of the following phases: Qualification Ranking, Qualifiers, Promotion Matches, Knockout Matches, and the Championship.

After the Global Stronghold War event opens, the system will tally the total combat power of all organization members worldwide and conduct qualification rankings based on the total combat power of organization members.
When the Qualification Ranking concludes, the top 512 organizations will qualify for the Qualifiers.
